metadata.description: The name of the Sentinel workspace

properties.description: Detects broken authentication session management including session fixation and insecure cookie flags
properties.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category contains 'gateway' | where RequestMethod == "POST" | where RequestUri has_any ("login", "auth", "session") | where ResponseCode in (200, 302) | where ResponseHeaders !contains "Secure" or ResponseHeaders !contains "HttpOnly" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 10m), resource_group, SourceIP | where count_ > 10
